sources.snippet: nightmedia/Qwen3.8-27B-Brainwaves architecture at a glance nightmedia/Qwen3.8-27B-Brainwaves is an image-text-to-text model (qwen3_5_text architecture). It uses 64 transformer layers, a hidden size of 5,120, and 24 query heads with 4 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use an intermediate size of 17,408.
